name: BotSieve – AI Crawlers Monitor
author: custonis

sections.description:
BotSieve – AI Crawlers Monitor helps you understand which AI companies and LLM crawlers are accessing your website.

The plugin automatically detects and logs popular AI bots and displays them in a modern dashboard directly inside WordPress.

Perfect for website owners, bloggers, publishers, SEO professionals and developers who want visibility into AI crawler activity.

Supported crawlers include:

  • OpenAI (GPTBot, ChatGPT-User, OAI-SearchBot)
  • Anthropic (ClaudeBot, Claude-SearchBot)
  • Meta AI
  • Google AI
  • Perplexity
  • ByteDance
  • Amazonbot
  • Applebot
  • Common Crawl
  • Diffbot
  • Cohere
  • and more

Features

  • Detect AI crawlers visiting your website
  • Monitor AI bot activity in real time
  • Modern AI dashboard interface
  • Live AI crawl timeline
  • Top AI crawlers overview
  • AI companies overview
  • Most crawled pages
  • Lightweight and fast
  • No external API required
  • Privacy friendly
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin to /wp-content/plugins/
  2. Activate the plugin through the WordPress admin
  3. Open “AI Crawlers” under the Tools menu
sections.faq:
Which AI crawlers are supported?

The plugin supports many popular AI crawlers including OpenAI, Anthropic, Meta, Google, Perplexity and more.

Does the plugin slow down my website?

No. BotSieve – AI Crawlers Monitor is lightweight and optimized for minimal overhead.

Does this plugin block AI crawlers?

No. This plugin focuses on detection and monitoring only.

Does the plugin use external APIs?

No. Everything runs locally inside your WordPress installation.
